latency.limitations: Tool and model phase intervals were recorded with UTC wall-clock timestamps, not a monotonic timer. They are descriptive observations only. Case timings use performance.now(). Local scripted PostgreSQL and CPU model with remote Neon are different environments, so timing is not a comparative speed claim. Human review wait is excluded by the evaluator. No p99 or significance claim.
